entries.note: Independent delta re-audit at worktree HEAD 8704efd8e (round 2; round-1 audit was a different run at 94ecb8983). Whole namespace read at the new bytes against en source; source/context/target sha256 re-derived from disk and match the translator draft. Checked: meaning, native idiom, glossary + style-guide terms vs the locale's shipped catalogue usage, display-cell widths (rich cell_len, CJK double-width) vs sidecar maxCells (chip 20/10, hotkey label 24, help 72, legend 44, tip 57) and vs the namespace's widest existing row (no layout widening), literal keys (⌥J/K, alt+g/G), placeholder/ICU parity, key-set parity, NFC/controls/stray spaces, fr U+202F before ';', ur no manual bidi controls. R1 MINOR fixed: half-page .help 76/75 -> 70/69 cells (<=72), matches requested wording. NITs (no change required): help rows say 'el cursor no se mueve' without the composer qualifier; up .help is 72/72 cells (at cap, no headroom). Note: en/tui.chrome.bindings.json was re-formatted (minified->pretty-printed, JSON-equal to the audited content) between rounds, so its source_sha256 moved dfe44861…->3189693e…; no wording change.

entries.note: Independent whole-namespace audit of the merge union at worktree HEAD 290a76c8c (parents c44fdf1ea tui-scroll-keys side, ce57801168 origin/main side). Purely additive: every one of the 44 keys is byte-equal to its text in a parent (10 base in both, 26 in origin/main 4e32078b2, 8 transcript in 8704efd8e); no key changed, none new. source/context/target sha256 re-derived with shasum -a 256 from disk and match the draft. Checked: meaning vs en, terminology identical across the two halves and vs shipped catalogue usage (transcript, composer, sidebar, aside, fork, pin, asks, dock, todo, effort, subagent, session, row/cursor), glossary + style guide, label/help register, display-cell widths (rich cell_len, CJK double-width) vs declared maxCells (24 label / 72 help on the 8 transcript rows, all within), literal tokens (/new /resume /sidebar /effort esc), NFC, controls, spacing, punctuation, key order parity. Findings (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR, 3 NIT): NIT B help rows drop 'in the composer' ('el cursor no se mueve'); no headroom (transcript_up.help 72/72). NIT toggle_asks label 'Consultas en cola' vs help 'preguntas' (tui.notifications consultas, tui.asks pregunta). NIT 3 A/base helps >72 cells (83/87/79); caps declared on transcript rows only.
